# dsh-handbook

> DeepSeek Harness (dsh) from-zero-to-one Chinese handbook — 11 chapters covering install, profiles, plugin development, performance tuning, tools/context, MCP & subagents, plus a same-model multi-agent benchmark and quickstart assets (cheatsheet, plugin template, config reference, FAQ). English PDF also available.
